paper_title: Counterfactual Influence as a Distributional Quantity
model_annotation: This plot illustrates the training and validation loss over a sequence of epochs. The x-axis is labeled "Epoch" and utilizes a linear scale ranging from 0 to 30, with numeric tick labels displayed at regular intervals of 5. The y-axis is labeled "Loss" and follows a linear scale ranging from 0.50 to 2.25, with numeric tick labels at intervals of 0.25. The plot contains two solid lines without markers, displayed against a light grey dashed grid. The "Train" line is dark blue and exhibits a smooth, steady decline across the x-axis, starting at approximately 1.79 at Epoch 0, dropping steeply to roughly 1.41 at Epoch 1, and then gradually decreasing to end at a value of approximately 0.51 at Epoch 29. The "Validation" line is dark green and displays a volatile trajectory; it begins at approximately 1.72 at Epoch 0, fluctuates between roughly 1.40 and 1.76 during the first 10 epochs, and reaches a prominent, sharp peak of approximately 2.19 at Epoch 11. Following this maximum peak, the validation line generally trends downward, featuring minor fluctuations such as a localized peak of 1.35 at Epoch 20, before concluding at approximately 0.98 at Epoch 29.
